::: {.callout-important}
## The course is in development
The roadmap contains **25 units, 101 lessons, 25 unit challenges, four numbered
milestone projects, and a six-stage capstone**. Lessons and challenges are not yet
released. Unit previews, readiness guidance, project outlines, and the smoke lab
are available now; previews do not count as completed lessons.
:::

## What makes the engineering visible?

- **Specify before running:** state success, budgets, permissions, and forbidden actions.
- **Start offline:** use deterministic fixtures before introducing model variability.
- **Inspect the run:** preserve tool calls, state transitions, errors, and resource use.
- **Compare with a baseline:** keep agents only when they improve the measured result.
- **Make failures teachable:** test boundaries, attacks, cancellation, and recovery.
- **Defend the decision:** explain limits and trade-offs, including when not to deploy.

## Choose your starting point

[Check your Python readiness](courses/agentic-ai-engineering/readiness.qmd),
[preview Unit 0](courses/agentic-ai-engineering/units/launch-agent-lab/index.qmd),
or [read the contributor guide](resources/contributing.qmd).

Core work is designed for Colab/Jupyter and a pinned local environment, without
paid services. Browser progress, when lessons are released, is local and
self-reported—not a verified assessment or certificate.
